title: Deep links: per-feature ownership via KSP
description: Define @OwnsDeepLinks annotation, generate handler registration and pattern/param metadata; optional manifest augmentation hooks.
acceptance_criteria: Annotation present and processed; per-feature handler ownership visible in generated registry.
Build fails on duplicate ownership for same host+path pattern.
At least one feature demonstrates handler end-to-end from URI -> typed destination.
tests: Unit: codegen mapping (patterns, params) for sample URIs.
Unit: collision detection for overlapping patterns.
Snapshot: generated registry diff is stable.
observability: Log: ownership conflicts flagged with feature and pattern

title: Deep links: app links verification & normalization
description: Digital Asset Links, canonicalization (trailing slashes, lowercase host), percent-encoding, UTM stripping, fallback routing.
acceptance_criteria: Asset links verified on at least API 30 and 34 devices/emulators.
Normalization produces canonical URIs for equivalent inputs.
Fallback route covers unknown paths without crash; records telemetry.
tests: Unit: normalization rules (trailing slash, case, percent-encoding, UTM removal).
Instrumentation: package manager app links verification passes.
adb: am start via https deep links lands on correct screen.

title: Saved state: entry-level SavedStateHandle persistence
description: Serialize typed destinations; lifecycle-aware persistence; process-death restore.
acceptance_criteria: Typed back stack serializes/deserializes across process death.
Cold start restore rebuilds identical destination payloads.
tests: Unit: serialization fidelity for all destination payloads.
Instrumentation: kill/restore scenario parity on top 3 flows.
observability: Log: restore.mismatch with diff of expected vs actual

title: Saved state: restore parity tests
description: Snapshot before kill -> restore equality; versioning/migration for destination payload changes.
acceptance_criteria: Snapshot comparator passes across 3 API levels for primary flows.
Destination payload version bump triggers migration with no data loss.

title: Predictive Back: top-of-stack handling
description: Intercept only top-of-stack for unsaved changes confirmation; avoid suppressing system predictive back; add tests.
acceptance_criteria: Top-of-stack screens with unsaved changes show confirm dialog; system back gesture remains predictive.
Lower stack entries never intercept back.
tests: UI test: predictive back gesture previews; confirmation on top screen only.
Unit: BackHandler enabled state toggles by stack position.

title: Kill switch (read-only) + telemetry expansion
description: Remote-config read-only gating of navigate/pop; emit nav events, deep link success/fail, restore results; graceful degradation.
acceptance_criteria: Toggling read-only prevents navigate/pop while logging intent.
Telemetry emitted for navigate/pop, deep link resolution, restore outcomes.
tests: Integration: telemetry events captured in test sink.
observability: Dash: restore success trend over time

title: Deep links: tests & device validation
description: Unit tests for handlers; instrumentation for Intent resolution; on-device verification; adb start tests across API levels.
acceptance_criteria: Device tests pass on API 26, 30, 34 with verified app links.
adb start flows land on expected destinations for all owned patterns.
tests: Unit: handler coverage ≥90% for owned patterns.
Instrumentation: view intents resolve correctly on emulator and device.
observability: Log: device.validation.fail with URI and reason

title: Multi-window & exported deep link activities
description: Exported entry activity with autoVerify; resizeableActivity=true; per-window back stacks; deep link handling per window.
acceptance_criteria: Deep links open in the correct window instance with isolated back stacks.
No cross-window state bleed; persistence works per window.
tests: Manual/device: split-screen deep link invocations per window.
Instrumentation: ensure separate back stacks per task/window.

title: Documentation & runbooks
description: Module template, deep link ownership ledger, KSP usage, test playbooks, app links verification, predictive back guidance.
acceptance_criteria: Published guide for adding a feature module with typed destinations and deep links.
Runbooks for app links verification and restore parity testing.
Ownership ledger includes all hosts/paths with responsible module.
tests: Doc lint/links check passes; examples compile where applicable.
